about: The pool the weekly batch draws from (see .claude/skills/weekly-batch). `person` is the exact spelling used in quotes.json. `sources` are translations the quote must be checked against word for word — public domain unless `copyrighted` is true, in which case quote briefly and verify against a scan (archive.org full text, publisher preview). `beware` lists famous lines that are NOT by this person. `sort_as` is the surname-index key when the last-word rule is wrong (every sort_as here is already mirrored in SORT_AS in js/app.js — keep the two in step if a name is added).
